_comment: SPONSORED / RECOMMENDED TILES for the Volo new-tab page. Plain links only — NO ad network, NO tracking, NO AdSense/AdMob code (putting ad code in a desktop app would violate Google policy and risk the AdSense account under review). Each tile: title + url + sponsored (true = shows a 'Sponsored' tag; false = plain placeholder/recommended tile). To add a real sponsor later, add an entry with sponsored:true. Empty tiles array = no Recommended section shown.
